posts.post:
Friendly reminder that your wardrobe is the interface you use to broadcast your competence to the world.

If your clothes look like everyone else's, your results will follow suit.

If you're not getting rejected, consider checking your risk tolerance before blaming the economy.

Average outcomes are the tax you pay for playing it safe.

Fun fact: Growth isn't a feeling. 

It is a series of uncomfortable decisions made when no one is watching.
